remarks: Located in a peaceful enclave of just four homes, this stunning freestanding townhouse is just one year old & conveniently situated near shops, theater, restaurants & the train station. Tucked away & surrounded by beautiful trees,stone walls & a private outdoor area, offering the perfect retreat for a modern lifestyle.With its charming board & batten siding, nine-foot ceilings, & abundant natural light, exuding elegance and warmth. The state-of-the-art kitchen boasts top-of-the-line appliances & a quartz waterfall center island, creating a stylish & functional workspace. The open concept living room & dining room, complete with a cozy fireplace, provide the ideal space for entertaining guests. Additionally, the first-floor office/den offers a quiet & private area to work or relax. Upstairs, the luxurious primary suite features vaulted ceilings & a spa-style bathroom with double sinks & a walk-in closet. Two spacious bedrooms, a second full bathroom, & a convenient laundry room complete the second floor. With a one-car garage & a full unfinished lower level, there is ample storage & potential for additional living space. Don't miss this opportunity to make this dream home yours!
